event_chain.summary: Privilege abuse - scouting/recruiting data taken and sent to rivals

summary: David Rudolph Jenrath, a player personnel scouting assistant for Auburn University's football program, was arrested on felony charges of theft of trade secrets and computer tampering after allegedly taking scouting reports, recruiting databases and prospect evaluations and sending them to competing football programs around July 19, 2026. At least one competitor school returned the materials to Auburn.
